expected_margin_detail: NBA Structural v8 (research). Same validated engine and constants as v7 -- the Phase 1/3 re-ablation of elo_home_advantage, home_court_points, B2B penalties, and a margin/market shrinkage term did not beat v7 defaults on the locked holdout (see qualification.ablation_note) -- plus two new, currently-neutral capability hooks: market_blend_weight (shrink expected_margin toward the market's own posted spread; 0.0 = v7-identical) and moneyline_margin_weight (independently tune how much the moneyline price trusts the margin signal vs pure Elo; defaulted to reproduce v7 exactly).
expected_margin_formula: 0.70 * elo_margin + 0.30 * trend_margin + 0.15 * rest_diff + availability_points_gap, then optionally shrunk toward market line by market_blend_weight
note: Research-status NBA v8 candidate from the 2026-11-02 overhaul investigation. NOT shadow_qualified, NOT wired into config/production.yaml. Ships as v7-equivalent (all new knobs at v7-reproducing defaults) because no ablated alternative beat v7 on the locked holdout; the real content of this artifact is the new dynamic per-player-availability capability (features/nba_player_availability.py::_estimate_player_impact_dynamic, use_dynamic_impact=True, not yet wired into any serving path because this repo has no real NBA box-score data source to validate it against) and the market-blend/moneyline-margin-weight hooks for future ablation once real historical spread-line history is joined to the training set.

qualification.ablation_note: scripts/ablate_nba_v7.py 2026-11-02: tested elo_home_advantage in {38(base),25,18,10}, home_court_points matched, b2b_penalty retune, and market_blend_weight in {0,0.2,0.35,0.5} / moneyline_margin_weight in {0.3(base),0.45,0.5,0.6} on a 60/20/20 chronological split of data/historical/nba_games_all.jsonl (2245 train / 885 validation / 651 holdout games). Best validation composite was v8_combo (market_blend_weight=0.2, moneyline_margin_weight=0.45), but on the locked holdout it did NOT clearly beat baseline v7: moneyline accuracy 0.6959 vs 0.6943 (baseline), brier 0.1954 vs 0.1952 (baseline, worse), margin MAE 12.55 vs 12.24 (baseline, worse). market_blend_weight could not be validated against real market signal because data/historical/nba_games_all.jsonl carries no historical spread-line field (the walk-forward harness used spread_away_line=0.0 for every game, so that ablation only measured shrinkage-to-zero, not a real market blend). Conclusion: keep v7's constants; do not promote this candidate on these results.
